Branded Merch for Customer Success Teams | Stitchi | Stitchi

# Gifting programs that drive retention and expansion

Your best customers deserve more than a thank-you email. Strategic gifting at onboarding, milestones, and renewals creates emotional loyalty that competitors can't replicate with discounts. We handle everything so your CSMs focus on relationships, not logistics.

When to Use This

Branded gifting gives CS teams a tangible way to reinforce value at critical moments in the customer journey.

How This Works

Set up automated gifting triggers or send on-demand. We handle the rest.

What We Handle

Everything a CS team needs to run gifting programs without becoming a logistics operation.

Can we automate gifts based on customer milestones?

Yes. We set up triggers based on onboarding stages, usage milestones, renewal dates, NPS scores, or any event from your CS platform. CSMs can also send on-demand for ad-hoc situations.

How do we handle different account tiers?

We create curated gift selections at multiple price points, typically 3-4 tiers matching your account segmentation. Each tier has pre-approved options so CSMs can send without additional approval.

What's the typical budget per customer gift?

Onboarding kits: $30-75. Milestone gifts: $50-100. Renewal gifts: $75-200. VIP/executive gifts: $150-500. We help you set appropriate tiers based on account value and lifetime revenue.

Does gifting actually impact retention?

Customers who receive thoughtful gifts at key moments report higher NPS scores and are more likely to renew. The key is timing: gifts tied to milestones and value moments outperform random swag.

Can CSMs personalize individual gifts?

Absolutely. CSMs can add personal notes, choose from pre-approved options, or request custom items for special situations. We balance personalization with operational efficiency.

How quickly can we ship a gift?

Stocked items ship same-day when triggered before 2pm ET. Custom or personalized items ship in 3-5 business days. We maintain inventory on your most-used items for instant availability.

What merchandise programs are most relevant?

Key programs include Customer Lifecycle Loyalty, Adoption Usage Milestone Gifts, Reactivation Winback Programs. Each addresses different objectives within your scope.

## Ready for a merch program that actually delivers?

500+ brands trust Stitchi to power programs that drive real results, from employee engagement to customer retention. Let's talk about what you're trying to accomplish.

- Free consultation, no commitment required
- Custom proposals within 48 hours
- Dedicated account manager from day one
